document.title: Politburo Session, January 24, 1989
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Afghanistan and the Soviet Withdrawal 1989 20 Years Later
document.note: Session on completing the withdrawal and the post-war Soviet role in Afghanistan. It shows a split in the leadership, with Shevardnadze arguing for leaving personnel behind to protect the Najibullah regime or delaying full withdrawal.
